summary: ⚠️ Critical Threat Detected (Score: 100/100). Do NOT transfer money or surrender personal banking credentials under any pretext.

indicators.name: Mandatory Upfront Payment or Security Deposit Demand
indicators.explanation: Legitimate employers and campus placement drives NEVER charge candidates registration, training, or equipment fees. Asking for "refundable" security deposits is the #1 signature of employment fraud.
indicators.verificationAction: Immediately refuse payment. Genuine companies provide all required equipment, software, and training at zero cost to the candidate.

indicators.name: Direct Money Transfer / Personal UPI / Cryptocurrency Channel
indicators.explanation: Recruitment processes do not conduct payments via personal UPI handles (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm) or direct bank wire instructions.
indicators.verificationAction: Do not transfer any funds. Real corporations maintain enterprise billing workflows and will never ask money to be sent to personal accounts.

indicators.name: Artificial Urgency & Coercive Pressure Tactics
indicators.explanation: Scammers manufacture artificial panic (e.g. 2-hour deadline, fear of losing seat, fake legal threats) to prevent students from consulting parents, mentors, or campus placement cells.
indicators.verificationAction: Step back and pause. Formal job offers give candidates at least 3 to 14 business days to review employment terms.

indicators.name: Official Offer Issued via Generic Free Email Service
indicators.explanation: While informal micro-startups sometimes use free emails, formal appointment letters and corporate agreements should originate from authenticated corporate domain names with SPF/DKIM records.
indicators.verificationAction: Request the recruiter to send an email confirmation from their registered corporate domain before taking further action.

indicators.name: Unconditional Direct Selection Without Assessment or Interview
indicators.explanation: Genuine employers always conduct at least one interview, coding assessment, or background check before issuing a job or internship offer. "Instant selection" is used by scammers to flatter and bait victims.
indicators.verificationAction: Inquire about the technical evaluation and request a live video interview with the hiring manager on Google Meet, Teams, or Zoom.

indicators.name: Unrealistic Compensation for Minimal / Low-Skill Work
indicators.explanation: Offering Rs 25,000/week or Rs 3,000/day for 1-2 hours of data entry, rating apps, or copy-pasting is statistically impossible in the real job market and is standard lure for advance-fee scams.
indicators.verificationAction: Compare offered wages against Glassdoor, AmbitionBox, or Payscale industry standards for the same position.

positiveSignals: Transparent, multi-round technical assessment process outlined.
